You are the controller of Genesis. It is your job to design a functional ecosystem that can maintain itself without reaching extinction, and to survive inside it as one of its animals.

control panel

interface size auto
start populationapplies on reset
founders placed on the island. Slider covers 2 to 500; type up to 2000.
mutation rate0.80
chance each gene mutates per birth. Live.
time scale0.010
how fast biological time runs against wall time. Live.
plant regrowth20
plant spawn attempts per biological second. Live.
plant energy10
energy in one plant before biome multipliers. Live.
day length10
length of one day/night cycle. Live.
season length5
length of one year, which drives seasons. Live.
corpse lifespan50
how long a corpse lies there. Live, applies to new corpses.
corpse yield0.5
multiplier on corpse energy. Live, applies to new corpses.
pre-run10
biological seconds to run the world before you enter it. 0 = you witness the very first generation. Takes effect on reset.
food patchiness0.50
how strongly food clusters into thickets and bare ground. Takes effect on reset.
founder diversity0.80
how far founders are pre-mutated apart. Takes effect on reset.
height variation1.00
how tall mountains and ridges rise, and how rough the general terrain is. 1 = default. Takes effect on reset.
water depth1.00
how deep the open ocean and inland lakes cut below the waterline. 1 = default. Takes effect on reset.
tree density1.00
fraction of eligible plants that render as full trees vs low ground cover. 1 = default. Live.
region density1.00
how large or small climate-driven biome regions (forest, plains, desert, tundra...) are. Higher = more, smaller patches. 1 = default. Takes effect on reset.

NEW GAME

move ↑ ↓   choose Enter   back Esc

Move

W A S Dwalk
hold Shiftsprint (uses stamina)
Spacejump; in the air, flap
Grear up on your hind legs to reach high food
drag Llook around / lock the mouse

Fly

Spaceflap: costs stamina, big wings beat slower
lookdive to gain speed, pull up to swoop and climb
A Dbank into a turn
Wtuck to dive faster
Sflare to slow down and land
thermalsrising air over open sunlit ground and hillsides

Fight

left click Fattack with your body
Xswitch attack
Q (hold)guard: raise it as the marker over an attacker turns yellow to parry
Z tap Shiftdodge roll
T middle clicklock on to a target

Survive

Eeat plants, fruit or the dead
Mmate: you become the offspring
Rroar: small animals scatter, big ones answer
Bcreature builder, any time

See and hear

C scrollfirst or third person
Vdetach the camera
Nsound on or off
Tabcontrol panel
[ ]simulation speed
Escrelease the mouse

Your attacks come from your body: a head-butt by default, a bite with jaws, a gore with horns, a claw swipe, a tail sweep, a spike slam or a punch with arms. Bigger bodies and bigger parts hit harder.

This build needs WebGPU, which this browser did not provide.

Chrome/Edge 113+ or Safari 18+ on a machine with a GPU will run it.
